title: Audit high-scaling physical scratch inventory and tape costs
body:
## Summary

Close PR2951's released local constructor/lease handoff for PR2915's unchanged high-field doubling and halving. Add a source-bound proof and replay against the complete real loader and `ScratchPool.install`.

```text
additional free roles = 7 + [S>1]
physical tape bill   = T + A < 530 BQS
A                   = 7 + 3B + 2BQ[S>1]
```

Here T is PR2951's logical invoice. Each actual acquisition adds exactly one blank-marker read. Only the returned output remains newly owned. The inventory proof excludes first exhaustion before assuming successful allocation.

This is a local tape-traffic and scratch-role result. Installation, initial markers, finite-control bookkeeping, total backing storage, general failure cleanup and a complete caller remain separate. PR2809's pending universal-refinement review is not discharged. No supplier admission or new kappa is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR2951 left physical factory traffic as conditional `T+aA`, without the actual pool binding or tight free-role count.
  **After:** the unchanged real installation attains seven/eight roles, with exactly `T+A` physical operations. A one-role-short pool rejects; an endpoint-preserving extra-marker-read mutant fails the invoice.
- Registered normal/optimized Python 3.12.15 replay passes 390 complete calls, 152,352 Boolean payload bits, eight occupied-pool cases and four real inventory rejections. All ten behavioral groups pass; optimized Python 3.14 replay and controls also pass.
- Separate internal read-only proof/source review reran the primary checker and ten controls without a blocking finding. No human or proof-assistant review is claimed.
- On refreshed main `916ecdd9d6e666fcad9b25369d055311f6ce8204`, registered replay passes, all 31 publication files match the commit, and 147 research-workflow tests run successfully with seven Linux-only skips on macOS. Lint/format pass. All 22 live input pins are unchanged from the scientific base `0614aba`.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/high-scaling-scratch-traffic
python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/high-scaling-scratch-traffic
```

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18975919). Scope changes from a whole selected-stock stage to this released local handoff are explicit in TASK.json. The package includes exact sources, receipt, bounded replay and open next questions.

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's PR2915/PR2809 implementation, David Arias's PR2753 caller, Arham Tahir's PR2877 countdown identity, PR2951's logical invoice and the retained selected/source lineage. Substantial automated assistance was used.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Isolated research package; production code, frozen sources and selected frontier are unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** research

The opt-in CI hook replays only this package and its declared dependencies. Local verification does not claim hosted CI or a complete multiplication theorem.
